origin.description: Convert central moments back to raw moments.

arguments.name: mu.central
arguments.text: Central moments from order 0 upward. In Python the argument is mu_central.

arguments.name: eta
arguments.text: The mean. One value for a vector, or one value per column.

origin.details: A vector mean must have length 1. A matrix or data frame needs one mean per column. A data frame comes back with columns named X1, X2, and so on, not the names it was given.
origin.value: Raw moments in the same positions as the central moments.
